research_question: Do company financial characteristics add predictive information beyond simple return benchmarks and common market conditions?
comparison: P1 vs historical mean; full model vs full-minus-financial; financial-only
evaluation: Paired OOS MSE with moving-block intervals; RMSE, MAE, OOS R2

research_question: Does starting valuation add information beyond the same financial and external controls?
comparison: Broad Ridge vs Broad Ridge minus valuation (frozen family); P2 vs P1; financial+valuation vs financial-only
evaluation: Paired OOS MSE, Holm-adjusted within the frozen family

research_question: Do first differences, percentage changes or changes in growth rates improve on factor levels?
comparison: Controlled P/E level vs difference vs percentage change vs lag; financial changes; P3 vs P2
evaluation: Matched OOS MSE, MAE and paired intervals

research_question: Do market, industry and relevant commodity/business drivers add value beyond financial and valuation variables?
comparison: Both cumulative ladders and leave-one-block-out, with derivatives removed alongside their block
evaluation: Paired OOS loss change in both orderings; grouped block permutation as a noncausal diagnostic

research_question: Do older predictor observations improve forecasts beyond the latest information?
comparison: Lag sets {0}, {0,1} and {0,1,3} on the same compact base inputs
evaluation: Paired OOS MSE and lag-length sensitivity; cumulative paired loss

research_question: Does a forecastable AR/MA error process improve on a static model using the same information?
comparison: Selected ARIMAX vs the matching ARMA(0,0) fit with identical inputs, likelihood and intercept convention
evaluation: Paired OOS MSE; AIC/BIC as training screens only

research_question: Do the main comparisons remain stable across forecast horizons, training windows and market regimes?
comparison: One- and three-month horizons; expanding vs rolling 84-month; origin-known volatility and rate regimes; calendar years
evaluation: Rolling 12-month loss, regime and horizon score tables; nonoverlapping offsets

research_question: Can the same information improve a separately defined forecast of realised variance?
comparison: Historical variance, EWMA, ARCH, GARCH, GARCH-X market/industry/business, regularised and tree variance models; individual vs pooled
evaluation: QLIKE primary; variance and volatility RMSE/MAE reported separately
